policy: Primary publisher/developer sources; exact game scope retained. Sources support precedents, not new prices or balance.

sources.game_scope: Street Fighter 6; move identity only, not Third Strike frame data
sources.title: Ryu official command list
sources.verified_support: Hadoken, Shoryuken and Tatsumaki move families. Their original Penny-Punchers roles and prices are design proposals.

sources.title: Guile official command list
sources.verified_support: Sonic Boom and Somersault Kick families; no charge or frame parity is inferred.

sources.title: Zangief, Lily, and Cammy complete the Street Fighter 6 launch roster
sources.verified_support: Zangief command throws and Tundra Storm grounded-kick counter; Cammy held specials. Does not establish Third Strike mechanics.

sources.title: Cammy official command list
sources.verified_support: Cannon Strike, Cannon Spike, Spiral Arrow and Hooligan move identities.

sources.publisher: Capcom; developer Tomoaki Ayano via ComboFiend
sources.game_scope: Ultra Street Fighter IV Omega; explicitly NOT ordinary SFIV or Third Strike
sources.title: An Introduction to the USFIV Omega Edition Characters: Part V
sources.verified_support: Dudley sway/follow-up/feint design, Yun Genei Jin combo interaction, Yang counter/rekka examples. Used qualitatively, never as a claim those Omega properties belong to Third Strike.

sources.title: See What Urien Brings to the Table in the September Update
sources.verified_support: Aegis is a placeable reflecting and damaging barrier; metallic aura is a move-bound armor example. No exact Third Strike unblockable setup is reproduced.

sources.game_scope: Street Fighter V implementation of returning moves
sources.title: Street Fighter V Summer Update 2021: Oro, Akira, and the reveal of the final character
sources.verified_support: Tengu Stone floating follow-up objects and expanded combo paths. The new design rejects its random object effects.

sources.game_scope: Street Fighter V; includes a returning Alpha move
sources.title: Street Fighter V: Winter Update announcements
sources.verified_support: Soul Satellite, Soul Dimension teleport and Soul Illusion shadow follow-ups offer different tactical roles.

sources.title: Dhalsim official command list
sources.verified_support: Grounded and aerial Yoga Teleport; actual proposed displacement/vulnerability are original.

sources.publisher: User conversation artifact / prior source audit
sources.title: Expanded economy audit
sources.verified_support: Twelve original rentals, one wallet, three slots, first-win threshold risks, unsupported rental policies and no purchasable global stats.
